alt: 戴著面鏡和浮力背心的人在淺水石灘尋找幾乎看不見的小針。
scene_prompt: 海底撈針 means an object is extremely difficult to find or an undertaking nearly impossible. At a very shallow calm clear-water inlet, a trained adult snorkeler wearing a proper mask and flotation vest carefully searches a broad pebbly seabed for one tiny lost sewing needle while a companion on shore checks the waterline. Show the huge expanse of stones and water around the nearly invisible needle to make the search seem extremely difficult. Safe knee-deep water only, no boats, deep diving or danger. Natural anatomy, limbs correctly positioned, mask and vest fit plausibly, clear waterline and pebble perspective. The small needle is just visible among pebbles, not oversized.
style_prompt: Create ONE original child-friendly picture-book illustration, landscape 3:2, delicate graphite pencil contours, soft watercolor and colored-pencil grain on warm ivory textured paper, natural blues, greens and warm sands. No text or logos.
